title: Cambodia Warns of ‘Aggressive’ Monkeys around Angkor Wat
titleZh: 柬埔寨警告吴哥窟周边'攻击性'猴子
credits: Agence France-Presse reported this story. Bryan Lynn adapted the report for VOA Learning English.

sentences.en: Cambodian officials are warning visitors to the nation’s famous Angkor Wat complex of buildings to stay away from wild monkeys.
sentences.zh: 柬埔寨官员警告游客远离该国著名的吴哥窟建筑群，不要靠近野生猴子。

sentences.en: They say the animals have become aggressive and destructive.
sentences.zh: 他们说，这些动物已变得具有攻击性和破坏性。

sentences.en: The officials blamed the behavior of the macaque monkeys on visitors to the area who feed the animals or interact with them.
sentences.zh: 官员们把猕猴的行为归咎于该地区的游客，是他们给动物喂食或与动物互动。

sentences.en: Social media influencers – many of them on YouTube – use video of the monkeys to grow their online followings, the officials added.
sentences.zh: 官员们补充说，许多社交媒体网红——其中不少人在YouTube上——利用猴子的视频来增加自己的网络粉丝。

sentences.en: The macaques are native to forest areas surrounding Angkor Wat, a UNESCO World Heritage Site in northwestern Cambodia.
sentences.zh: 猕猴是柬埔寨西北部吴哥窟周边森林地区的原生动物种，吴哥窟已被列为联合国教科文组织世界遗产。

sentences.en: The monkeys have become more destructive of property around the popular tourist area.
sentences.zh: 这些猴子对这一热门旅游区的财产造成了更大的破坏。

sentences.en: Officials watching the animals told the French News Agency, AFP, that too much human interaction – especially by people filming material to publish online – had changed the monkeys’ behavior.
sentences.zh: 负责观察这些动物的官员向法新社（AFP）表示，过多的人类互动——尤其是有人拍摄素材并发布到网上——改变了猴子的行为。

sentences.en: The agency that operates Angkor Wat is the APSARA National Authority.
sentences.zh: 运营吴哥窟的机构是吴哥窟APSARA国家管理局。

sentences.en: It said in a statement that a small number of YouTubers repeatedly feed the monkeys to create videos.
sentences.zh: 该局在一份声明中表示，少数YouTube博主反复给猴子喂食以制作视频。

sentences.en: This "changed the monkeys' natural behavior from being wild animals to domestic ones that are aggressive, steal food, and cause injuries among people."
sentences.zh: 这"改变了猴子的自然行为，使它们从野生动物变成了具有攻击性、偷取食物并伤人的人"。

sentences.en: Agency spokesman Long Kosal told AFP that officials also worry about the monkeys causing damage to stonework that dates back centuries.
sentences.zh: 该局发言人龙卡索尔（Long Kosal）告诉法新社，官员们还担心猴子会对数百年前的石构建筑造成破坏。

sentences.en: "On top of biting visitors, they have been climbing up and pushing stones down, damaging temples," he said.
sentences.zh: "除了咬伤游客外，他们还爬上并推下石块，损坏了寺庙，"他说。

sentences.en: Some macaques had also damaged information signs.
sentences.zh: 一些猕猴还损坏了信息标志牌。

sentences.en: Local officials have urged tourists to leave the monkeys alone while visiting Angkor Wat.
sentences.zh: 当地官员敦促游客在游览吴哥窟时不要打扰猴子。

sentences.en: They added that they are currently looking for "an appropriate solution" to solve the problem.
sentences.zh: 他们补充说，目前正在寻找"适当的解决方案"来解决这一问题。

sentences.en: Angkor Wat was the capital of the Khmer Empire.
sentences.zh: 吴哥窟曾是高棉帝国的首都。

sentences.en: Building work began on the complex about 900 years ago.
sentences.zh: 这座建筑群的建设工程始于约900年前。

sentences.en: It remains Cambodia's top tourist site and earns a lot of money for the developing nation.
sentences.zh: 它至今仍是柬埔寨最热门的旅游胜地，为这个发展中国家带来大量收入。

sentences.en: More than one million foreign tourists visited the area last year.
sentences.zh: 去年，超过100万外国游客参观了该地区。

sentences.en: Since becoming a world heritage site in 1992, Angkor Wat and the surrounding forest have received increased legal protection and security.
sentences.zh: 自1992年被列为世界遗产以来，吴哥窟及其周边森林获得了更强的法律保护和安全保障。

sentences.en: Officials have expressed hope that wildlife sightings around Angkor Wat will increase visitor interest and support conservation education efforts.
sentences.zh: 官员们表达了对在吴哥窟周边地区出现野生动物目击事件的希望，认为这将增加游客兴趣并支持保护教育工作。

sentences.en: Last year, Cambodian officials announced a plan to carry out a census of monkeys in public areas to identify and take away those presenting a danger to humans.
sentences.zh: 去年，柬埔寨官员宣布了一项在公共区域对猴子进行普查的计划，以识别并移除那些对人类构成危险的猴子。

sentences.en: I’m Bryan Lynn.
sentences.zh: 我是布莱恩·林恩。
